coverage.name: City of Creede (town)
limitations: Participating: the August 4, 2026 board packet contains the Mineral County Election Services Intergovernmental Agreement for the November 3, 2026 election, and the August 4 minutes record the board authorizing its execution.
The county ballot could not be read (see the Mineral County row), so the state is source_unreadable.

Excluded, from the city's referring resolutions in the August 4 packet: Resolution No. 26-26 (publishing ordinances by title only) and Resolution No. 26-27 (not publishing bills and contract proceedings in a newspaper). Neither concerns housing. Ballot letters are not known.
A lodging or short-term-rental tax was discussed at board meetings in July to September 2026; minutes through September 15 show no referral of it to the 2026 ballot.
